idea.title: The bottle that took 108 years
idea.summary: A bottle thrown into the sea in 1906 is found on a German beach in 2015 by a stranger who mails the card back, closing on how little waiting a call needs.
hookOptions: A stranger replied to a bottle note 108 years later
Someone threw a bottle in the sea. 108 years later, a reply.
Nobody replied for 108 years. Then someone did.
A note from 1906 finally got an answer
sources: Wikipedia: Message in a bottle: oldest message found at the time, released 1906 by the Marine Biological Association (Plymouth, England) in a current study, found 2015 by Marianne Winkler on the German island of Amrum, about 108 years.
Wikipedia: Message in a bottle: the bottle held a postcard asking the finder to return it to the Association.

scenes.say: Someone threw a bottle in the sea, and a stranger replied 108 years later.
A research group in England tossed it in the water in 1906.
Marianne Winkler found it on a German island beach in 2015.
She opened it. The card said please send me back.
That bottle waited 108 years for a stranger. Your call waits seconds.

post.caption: A bottle thrown into the sea in 1906 got its reply in 2015, from a stranger on a beach. Would you have mailed it back? Your reply doesn't have to wait 108 years: randomtalker.com
